description: Defines a Drupal widget class 'EntityReferenceAutocompleteWidget' for an autocomplete entity reference field, including configuration, form rendering, and autocreation logic.

classes.name: EntityReferenceAutocompleteWidget
classes.description: A Drupal widget class providing an autocomplete text field for entity references, with configurable matching options and autocreation support.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default configuration settings for the widget, including match operator, limit, size, and placeholder.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the widget, allowing users to set matching method, result limit, size, and placeholder.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current widget settings for display in the admin interface.

methods.name: formElement
methods.description: Generates the form element for entity reference autocomplete, including handling autocreate options.

methods.name: errorElement
methods.description: Specifies which form element should be used to display validation errors.

methods.name: massageFormValues
methods.description: Processes submitted form values to handle autocreated entities and move nested target_id data up a level.

methods.name: getAutocreateBundle
methods.description: Determines the bundle to use for autocreated entities based on field settings.

methods.name: getSelectionHandlerSetting
methods.description: Retrieves specific settings from the entity reference handler configuration.

methods.name: getMatchOperatorOptions
methods.description: Provides available options for the autocomplete matching method.
